observation: Board panel, coherent. Iso: a flat slab with the playing grid cut into its face as shallow square-bottomed grooves and five deeper square terrain pockets, all on the cell grid, with a plain border round the field. Front view: one slab of constant thickness with no protrusion. The top view is featureless because the renderer is flat-shaded and every pocket floor is parallel to the face; the iso resolves it. No missing or extra pocket, no floating geometry, no visible intersection.
